god_relations.myth: Recovery of the chief’s severed arm
god_relations.note: He scalds the Thunder-beings, recovers the stolen arm, and escapes their storm.

god_relations.myth: Recovery of the chief’s severed arm
god_relations.note: Iktomi throws him into a boiling pot; Falling Star overturns it and scalds him.
Stone Boy withstands Iya’s poison, blows, and deception, then defeats him.
Stone Boy flattens Iya’s hands and feet, interrogates him, and later tramples him.
Under duress, Iya reveals how Stone Boy can restore the flattened victims.
Cajete interprets Stone Boy as primordial Iŋyáŋ come to life on earth.

god_relations.myth: The Stone Boy and the Spider
god_relations.note: The manuscript title attests a joint narrative, but the interaction and Spider’s identity remain uncertain.
god_relations.source: Allison, The Stone Boy and the Spider

Buffalo Woman.note: Stone Boy defeats an old Buffalo Woman at ball in an attached cycle.

Eagle.note: Eagle gives Falling Star a plume for protection or transformation.

Flying Ant.note: A live flying ant accompanies him as a magical helper of unclear function.

Large/Bright Star.note: He is Falling Star’s celestial father and chief of a star camp.

Magpie.note: Magpie finds Falling Star alive after his mother’s fatal fall.
Magpie summons the animals and renames Star Comes Out as Falling Star.

Meadowlark.note: His foster-grandfather raises him, teaches survival skills, and sends him outward.
In the Cheyenne version, Meadowlark gives him a bow and feathered arrows.

Split-tailed Swallow.note: The swallow gives a feather enabling Falling Star’s extremely rapid flight.

Star People.note: Contemporary teaching says he returns to his father’s celestial people.

Water Monster.note: After being swallowed, Falling Star cuts the monster open with a star-stone.

Waziya.note: Falling Star reverses Waziya’s magic, breaks his power, and restores food.

Waziya Wicahpi.note: Contemporary Lakota teaching names the stationary North Star as Falling Star’s father.

White Crow.myth: White Crow and the buffalo famine
White Crow.note: Falling Star captures the buffalo-warning White Crow, ending its power over hunting.

Wren.note: Wren gives Falling Star a feather enabling transformation into wren form.
Wren instructs Falling Star how to infiltrate the Thunder camp.
